# Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.2.2
This revision fixes an error that would occur when patching the game if the client is connected to a room that uses a password. This update also includes game mod version 20.2. Both the updated .apworld and game mod version 20.2 should be safe to use with pre-existing seeds from v2.2.0 or v2.2.1.

NOTE: I replaced the .apworld file ~3h after this was posted because I forgot to bump the internal version of the client. Whoops lol. The client will now correctly report v2.2.2 when starting up.

# Changelog (compared to v2.2.1)
1) [.apworld update] Fixed an error that would occur (new to v2.2) if connecting to a room that uses a password. The underlying reason for the error relates to a longstanding quirk in how the client initializes, but it only became problematic due to changes made when adding PAL support to the client.
2) [game mod update] Removed the "You've collected everything" message that displays when reaching 100%. This message would sometimes get spammed if you use Dragon Eggs as filler items and get sent too many of them.
3) [game mod update] The Bounce trap now synchronizes with the BPM (beats per minute) of the currently playing music track. The bounces themselves wont' always line up with the track, but he will bounce at the same frequency. I prefer to call it bounces per minute, personally...

[Setup Guide](https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Spyro:-AHT-1-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ)
